summary: Wheeler Real Estate Investment Trust filed an 8-K under items 3.02 and 8.01 reporting multiple private exchanges of Series B and D convertible preferred stock for common stock with unaffiliated holders. Between June 26 and July 2, 2026, it issued approximately 2.12 million common shares for roughly 173,383 preferred shares, at exchange ratios of 7-76 common per preferred share. No board recommendation, advisor, or premium is stated; these are routine equity conversion transactions, not a special situation. The filing discloses unregistered sales, not an acquisition, divestiture, or other event-driven category.
